auth_details: HTTP Basic: Merchant ID as username, Secret Key as password (base64-encoded pair). Alternative: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials — POST grant_type=client_credentials to merchant-auth.afterpay.com/v2/oauth2/token, then Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
resolution_notes: auth.details: Auditor correct. Official Afterpay docs confirm Basic auth (Merchant ID = username, Secret Key = password) and OAuth 2.0 client-credentials Bearer tokens as the second method. Evidence: https://developers.afterpay.com/afterpay-online-developer/api-reference/reference/introduction/authentication
